summary: Zeta Network Group filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its September 10, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, where holders of 3,084,434 shares (about 67.79% of 4,550,126 outstanding) approved three ordinary/special resolutions: an eight-for-one share consolidation effective July 27, 2026, adoption of tenth amended articles, and a share capital reduction and reorganization under Cayman Companies Act sections 14, 14A and 14B. No acquisition, tender, activist or going-private event is present; this is a routine meeting-result filing, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
